title: Sebastian Markbage: Minimal API Surface Area | JSConf EU 2014
summary: Sebastian Markbage explains how React is moving toward a minimal API surface by leaning on language features and patterns instead of dedicated framework APIs. He also touches on JSX and syntax proposals for future JavaScript.
why: HN cites it as a statement of React's early design philosophy of keeping APIs small and understanding JavaScript itself.

quote.text: I found this talk on the topic very interesting
